facts.raw_span: A man in his 40s presented with a new pigmented lesion on his left second toenail
The lesion first appeared 12 months before presentation and was progressively growing
The lesion was asymptomatic
He was otherwise well and denied any fevers or weight loss
dark brown longitudinal pigment band covering the full length of the toenail of the left second digit with corresponding nail thickening over the pigmented band
The pigment was the same width throughout the band and extended to the proximal nail fold
No other nail or skin lesions were found at the time of examination
Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium
No melanocytic lesions observed
Immunostaining negative for S100 and CD34
Intracorneal hemorrhage and adjacent verrucous hyperkeratosis present
Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia

concepts.why: Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate are characteristic of onychomatricoma

The presence of a dark brown longitudinal pigment band covering the full length of the toenail is suggestive of a melanocytic nevus, although the histopathologic examination did not show melanocytic lesions
The presence of nail thickening over the pigmented band is consistent with onychauxis
The presence of intracorneal hemorrhage and adjacent verrucous hyperkeratosis is consistent with subungual keratosis
The presence of bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium is consistent with nail plate fibroma
The presence of a dark brown longitudinal pigment band covering the full length of the toenail is consistent with longitudinal melanonychia
The absence of melanocytic lesions and negative immunostaining for S100 and CD34 explain the uncovered findings of no melanocytic lesions observed and negative immunostaining results.

rationales.F05: The presence of a dark brown longitudinal pigment band is more typical of onychomatricoma or nail plate fibroma, but less typical of nail unit melanocytic nevus or longitudinal melanonychia.
rationales.F06: The uniform width of the pigment band and its extension to the proximal nail fold are more characteristic of onychomatricoma or nail plate fibroma.
rationales.F08: Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix is highly suggestive of onychomatricoma.
rationales.F09: The absence of melanocytic lesions rules out nail unit melanocytic nevus and longitudinal melanonychia.
rationales.F10: Negative immunostaining for S100 and CD34 further supports the diagnosis of onychomatricoma over nail unit melanocytic nevus or longitudinal melanonychia.
rationales.F12: Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia are characteristic of onychomatricoma.

frontier_selector.rationale: Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia support Onychomatricoma, with Nail plate fibroma as a close runner-up due to similar histopathologic findings but less specific clinical correlation.
